items.title: Flights to and from Indonesia’s capital resume after volcanic eruption forced a 2-day closure
items.summary: Flights to and from Indonesia’s capital of Jakarta have resumed after ash from a volcanic eruption forced a two-day closure that halted nearly 3,000 flights

items.title: Delhi Buildings Over 50 Years Old To Face Safety Audits: Minister
items.summary: Manohar Lal Khattar said the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs is considering a plan to conduct safety audits of all DDA buildings that are more than 50 years old.
